ModMetaData.name: Nice Health Tab: Recolorized
ModMetaData.author: gfrov
ModMetaData.description:
Adds an interactive in-game color palette, dynamic body substrate tinting, and graphical support for prosthetics and implants in Nice Health Tab.
[h1]Features[/h1] [list] [*] [b]Interactive Color Palette:[/b] Choose custom colors for each tier (Advanced Bionics, Ultratech, Archotech, Standard Bionics, and Simple Prosthetics) using RimWorld's native HSV color wheel and saturation-value square with live preview. [*] [b]Dynamic Body Silhouette Tinting:[/b] When your colonist's limbs are replaced with a dominant prosthetic tier (configurable threshold from 1 to 4 limbs), the body doll silhouette is tinted in that tier's color. [*] [b]Synchronized Hand & Foot Icons:[/b] The separate hand and foot icons at the bottom dynamically reflect the exact color of installed arm/leg prosthetics. [*] [b]YAPEM Integration:[/b] Full graphical doll support for Advanced Bionic and Ultratech limbs from "Yet another prosthetic expansion mod". [*] [b]Authentic Archotech Color:[/b] Replaces the overly green archotech textures with authentic sage-green (#CBD0AB). [*] [b]DLC Implants Recolor:[/b] Dedicated color categories and live preview for official DLCs (Royalty, Biotech, Anomaly, Odyssey). [*] [b]Interactive Pawn Preview:[/b] Live mannequin in mod options showing real-time tinting of limbs, silhouette, and internal organs. [*] [b]Universal Mod Compatibility:[/b] Automatically detects and recolors archotech, bionic, and ultratech implants from third-party mods (Integrated Implants, Archotech Expanded, EPOE-Forked, etc.) via TechLevel and def tags. [*] [b]Multi-Language Support:[/b] Fully localized into 18 languages. [/list]
[h1]Dependencies[/h1] [list] [*] [b]Harmony[/b] [*] [b]Nice Health Tab[/b] [/list]
[h1]Recommended Mods[/h1] [list] [*] [b]Nicer Health Tab[/b] [*] [b]Yet another prosthetic expansion mod (YAPEM)[/b] [/list]
